title: Import Apify dataset to HubSpot company

hubspotAccessToken.title: HubSpot access token
hubspotAccessToken.description: Your HubSpot access token. Works with both private app tokens (from Settings > Integrations > Private Apps) and OAuth access tokens.

datasetId.title: Dataset
datasetId.description: Select the Apify dataset containing enrichment data.

companyId.title: HubSpot company ID
companyId.description: The HubSpot company ID to update with data from the dataset.

dataMappings.title: Field mappings
dataMappings.description: Map dataset fields to HubSpot company properties. 'source' uses dot notation (e.g. 'metadata.industry'), 'target' is the internal HubSpot property name (e.g. 'industry').

source.title: Source field
source.description: Dot-notation path in the dataset item (e.g. 'revenue' or 'metadata.industry').

target.title: HubSpot property
target.description: Internal name of an existing HubSpot company property (e.g. 'annualrevenue', 'industry').
